title: Demons as the spirits of dead Nephilim giants
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Demons as the spirits of dead Nephilim giants, about antediluvian to present at Earth, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Demons according to ancient Hebrew cosmology are the disembodied spirits of dead giants that persist in the world.
Remember I said in the book of Enoch that when this when the giants were killed that their spirits departed their bodies
tellings.difference: Credits the Book of Enoch specifically, where the story's telling says 'ancient Hebrew cosmology', and describes the spirits leaving the giants' bodies when they were killed.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell the claim that the spirits of the dead giants became demons; the teller is the same.

as_told.title: Book of Enoch: spirits of dead giants become demons

plain: Filmmaker and researcher Tim Alberino tells Jesse Michels that, in ancient Hebrew belief, demons are the bodiless spirits of dead giants, the Nephilim of old Jewish texts. He points to the Book of Enoch, an ancient Jewish writing left out of most Bibles, and says it describes the giants' spirits leaving their bodies when they were killed and lingering in the world ever since. If true, it would explain where evil spirits come from.
